messages:
maria: FYI hitting a flaky repro on the Mac sample app after laptop sleep. Streaming SSE fragments sometimes duplicate the final token and our parser throws a malformed-final-token error.

maria: Repro steps: open sample app, start streaming -> close lid (sleep) -> open lid -> app reconnects and we see duplicate final tokens in logs. Happens on macOS 13/14.

samir: Can you paste the raw socket/log output?

maria: Sure, here's the snippet (redacted). note the split/dup of final chunk:
```
[2026-03-02T15:10:03.123Z] RECV: data: {"id":"evt_1","text":"hello"}
[2026-03-02T15:10:03.124Z] RECV: data: {"id":"evt_1","text":"world"}
[2026-03-02T15:10:10.400Z] NETWORK: TCP FIN (sleep)
[2026-03-02T15:10:15.002Z] RECONNECT
[2026-03-02T15:10:15.010Z] RECV: data: {"id":"evt_1","text":"world"}
[2026-03-02T15:10:15.011Z] RECV: data: [DONE]
[2026-03-02T15:10:15.012Z] PARSE ERROR: unexpected duplicate final token
```

maria: Looks like the tail fragment `world` + `[DONE]` is replayed after reconnect. Parser sees the final token twice.

tay: Interesting — we saw similar on Linux but with a different trigger (auth refresh). Is Swift client doing any automatic buffered-replay?

ben: Quick dev note: Node SDK had an autodrawoff where we re-enqueue in-flight fragments on auth retry. Might be parity issue: python path uses last-event-id + dedupe, node replays.

samir: marai (typo) — maria, can you confirm whether the sample app is using the latest SDK pinned version?

maria: It's using the local sample SDK from repo at commit 5b3f2a (no dedupe logic).

ben: Workaround for now: add a short-lived seen-final-token boolean to client stream session. If final seen, ignore subsequent `[DONE]` tokens for same stream id. Not ideal but low risk.

tay: Agree. Also add a small unit test that simulates socket FIN + immediate reconnect with duplicate tail fragments. Should catch this in CI.

maria: Will try the workaround and post results. Also we should add a note to onboarding docs: "Mac sleep can cause ephemeral TCP teardown; SDKs should tolerate duplicate tail fragments."

samir: If you can repro reliably, can we get a tiny sample harness for the team to run? I can add a flaky e2e test in the sample app repo.

maria: I'll record a short repro script and upload.

ci-bot: CI run queued for sampleapp/streaming #462 — will report back on flaky test once added.

tay: Long term: SDKs should converge on idempotent fragment processing (sequence/last-event-id). Add a parity checklist item.

maria: Thanks — I'll open a small PR for the quick fix + docs note.

ben: :thumbsup:

samir: Thanks — appreciate the clear repro.
